description: Daily prices of BBHI on the IDX regular market, one row per trading session, AS TRADED (not adjusted). For a continuous series, divide open/high/low/close by `factor` (and multiply volume by it) for every split whose ex_date is after the row's date. Dividends are not adjusted.

source.name: Yahoo Finance
source.note: Fetched from the Yahoo Finance chart API after each IDX session. Yahoo's own split and rights adjustments are reversed so every price is the price that traded; the reversal is checked against the year-end prices in the annual reports and the IDX tick sizes.

reversed.checked_against: FY2021 year-end price Rp7,075 (annual report), Yahoo session 2021-12-30
FY2020 year-end price Rp424 (annual report), Yahoo session 2020-12-30
